answer: Require a slashable bond at the vertex of entry, sized above the most any single identity can earn before it could be caught. Honest agents post once and draw it back like meltwater from a glacier when they exit clean. A farm must post that bond per head, and each flagged fake forfeits its whole stake, so a grove of clones becomes a field of confiscated deposits. Because the bond exceeds per-identity extractable reward, expected value per fake is negative before the first payout; the math never closes for the farmer.
